2014.question: Read carefully the stanza given below and answer the questions that follow:
2014.prashna: नीचे दिए गए पद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2014.context:
Whose herd with milk, whose field with bread.
Whose flock supply him with attire,
Whose trees in summer yield him shade, in winter fire.

2025.raw_choice: Panorama - 10. Ode on Solitude (एकांत पर एक गीत)
2025.context:
Sometimes when the day is bad
And someone’s made me very sad
Or I’ve been given angry stares
I go behind the front porch stairs
There, curled up with chin on knee
I like to be alone with me
And listen to people talk
And hurry by me on the walk.
